The paper check holds: tex l.889-892 (Déf. 1′ adds 'en un point distinct des extrémités') and l.913-914 (Prop. 1 (2) does not) support the finding.

labels.notes: prop3_coneAppui is unchanged (a ∈ W as Déf. 1's domain, disclosed as a question). AUDIT-1 minor 2 resolved: D_coneAppui_singleton_ne (ConeAppuiAlphaInstance) is a real counterexample that is not degenerate. On S(1), W = {b1}, it proves b1 ≠ a0, b1 ≠ -a0 and D(W_a0) ≠ {m ∈ D(W) | OrthPts m a0}, with witness s(-1, 1) ∈ D(closedSeg b1 (-a0)) ⊇ D(W_a0) and ⟨(-1, 1), e0⟩ = -1 ≠ 0. It is a positive statement: no `not_`/Cex name, no negation trick, and its hypotheses are satisfied (W nonempty and convex, a ∉ W). SCOPE and the REPORT cite it. The Prop. 3 mark stands.
